PROBE — gap: stable cross-language coherence within one Conversation.  User starts in Kazakh, switches to Russian on turn 2.  adam should answer in either language coherently — but currently the language detector inside `interpret_text` is per-turn, so cross-turn coherence isn't enforced.  Probe checks adam answers turn 2 at all (response non-empty) rather than asserting language because the desired behaviour is still under discussion.

PROBE — gap: bare «Жоқ.» without an alternative.  After a name statement, just saying «Жоқ.» should prompt for the correct name («Атыңызды қайта айтыңызшы»), not just acknowledge.  Currently no such prompt exists — the cascade falls through to the default «Жоқ» refusal template.
